blocks.3: in Brandangersundet in the spring of 1987.
blocks.6: our thoughts are sad and heavy;
blocks.7: the village has lost three of its young.
blocks.9: the village community stands in grief.
blocks.10: Three coffins stood in the church;
blocks.14: where they live as they were
blocks.15: – where we will always have them.
blocks.18: we stand close to those who mourn;
blocks.19: we know how heavy this is.
blocks.27: but the light the boys lit
blocks.31: the joy they brought to the home.
